en.theme: Faith, food and football: growing up in Madinah

prompts.title: Stories of Umar ibn al-Khattab
prompts.activity: Share a short, well-loved story about Umar ibn al-Khattab, such as his walks at night to check on the people, and take your time with it.

prompts.title: Reading about the Companions

prompts.title: A pot of biryani

en.theme: Old Cairo: lanes, gardens, koshari and match days
en.opener: Today let's take a slow walk back to Cairo, with its busy old lanes, green gardens and good food. There are no right or wrong answers, just stories to share.

prompts.title: Stories of Cairo's alleys
prompts.activity: Read aloud a short passage from a Naguib Mahfouz novel set in old Cairo, in whichever language feels most comfortable, and pause often.
prompts.question: Tell me what the streets and neighbours in this story bring to mind for you.

prompts.title: A bowl of koshari
prompts.activity: Make or buy koshari together. Layer the rice, lentils and pasta, then add the tomato sauce and crispy onions.
prompts.question: Tell me what a good plate of koshari should taste like.

prompts.title: Wandering the old bazaar
prompts.activity: Look through photos of Khan el-Khalili together: the spice stalls, the lanterns, the crafts and the old cafés.
prompts.question: Tell me about the sounds and smells you picture in a market like this.

prompts.title: Roses and papyrus in the garden
prompts.activity: Look at pictures of Orman Garden's roses, palms and papyrus, or sit with fresh flowers and enjoy their scent together.
prompts.question: Tell me about a garden or green spot that you enjoyed.

prompts.title: Football days with Al Ahly
prompts.activity: Look at old photos of Al Ahly in their red shirts, or watch a few highlights of a classic match together.
prompts.question: Tell me what a big match day felt like around you.

prompts.title: A family dish
prompts.activity: Cook {{familyDish}} together, or set out its ingredients and talk while you prepare it.
prompts.question: Tell me about the kitchen when {{familyDish}} was being made.

prompts.title: Someone close
prompts.activity: Look through photos of {{relative}} together and let them lead the way.
prompts.question: Tell me about the times you spent with {{relative}}.

caregiverTips: Go slowly and follow their lead. If a prompt doesn't spark anything, move on to the next one.
Enjoy the stories as they come, without correcting dates or details.
Mahfouz's novels are closely tied to the old Gamaliya quarter and Khan el-Khalili, so the book and the bazaar make a natural pair.
Food and scents often open up the warmest conversations, so cook together if you can.
Keep the session short and end on something pleasant, like a cup of tea or a favourite treat.

ar.opener: اجلسا معًا في مكان هادئ ومريح، مع كوب من الشاي. ابدأ بالقول: يسعدني أن نقضي بعض الوقت معًا اليوم ونتحدث عن القاهرة وأيام زمان. ليس هناك جواب صحيح أو خاطئ، فقط نستمتع بالحكايات.

prompts.title: صفحات من نجيب محفوظ
prompts.activity: اقرأ بصوت هادئ فقرة قصيرة من رواية لنجيب محفوظ تصف حارات القاهرة ومقاهيها وأهلها، ثم توقف ودع الحديث يأخذ مجراه.
prompts.question: يسعدني أن أسمع عن الشوارع والحارات التي تشبه ما يكتبه نجيب محفوظ في القاهرة التي عشت فيها.

prompts.title: طبق كشري دافئ
prompts.activity: حضّرا معًا طبق كشري بسيطًا، أو اشترياه وتناولاه سويًا، واتركا رائحة الصلصة والبصل المقرمش تفتح باب الحديث.
prompts.question: احكِ لي عن الكشري في أيام شبابك، أين كنت تأكله ومع من؟

prompts.title: فطور شعبي مصري
prompts.activity: جهّزا فطورًا شعبيًا مصريًا من الفول والطعمية والعيش البلدي، وتناولاه ببطء معًا.

prompts.title: النادي الأهلي

en.theme: Istanbul days: stories, simit and Saturday football
en.opener: I brought a few things that remind me of Istanbul: a warm simit, a book by Yaşar Kemal and a little bit of red and yellow. Let's sit together, have something to eat and see where the conversation goes.

prompts.title: Galatasaray match days

prompts.title: Fresh simit

prompts.title: A plate of baklava

prompts.title: Time with family
prompts.activity: Look through family photos together and let them point out whatever catches their eye.
prompts.question: Tell me about the times you spent with {{relative}}.

en.theme: Growing up in Kuala Lumpur: badminton, kites, trips to Penang and good Malaysian food

prompts.title: Badminton days
prompts.activity: Hold a badminton racket and shuttlecock together, or gently tap a shuttlecock back and forth indoors.
prompts.question: Tell me about playing or watching badminton when you were young.

prompts.title: A plate of nasi lemak

prompts.question: Tell me about the Malay food you loved most growing up.

prompts.title: Evenings at the mamak stall

prompts.question: What was it like sitting at a mamak stall with friends?

prompts.title: A trip to Penang
prompts.activity: Look through old photos or a picture book of Penang island together.
prompts.question: Tell me about Penang and what it felt like to be there.

prompts.title: Flying kites
prompts.activity: Make a simple paper kite together, or watch kites flying in an open field.
prompts.question: Tell me about flying kites. Where did you like to fly them?

prompts.title: Time with family
prompts.activity: Sit together with a cup of tea and look at family photos.
prompts.question: Tell me about the times you spent with {{relative}}.

prompts.title: A family dish

prompts.question: Tell me about {{familyDish}} and who used to make it.

caregiverTips: Follow their lead. If one topic sparks joy, stay with it and skip the rest.
Correcting details doesn't matter. Enjoy whatever stories come up.
Smells and tastes can bring back feelings, so cooking together is often a lovely way to start.
If they seem tired or upset, gently change the subject or take a break.
Keep sessions short, about 20 to 30 minutes, and end on a happy note.
limitations: None of the Qloo taste recommendation calls succeeded, because the age group was written in a format Qloo does not accept. Nothing on this card shows what people of this generation in Malaysia tended to like.
The sources are only Qloo tags and place names found through setup lookups. They are general topics, not specific players, dishes, stalls, landmarks or kite-flying places.
Qloo had no nasi lemak tag. The nasi lemak prompt relies on the general Malay cuisine tag and on the family's own mention of the dish.

The Penang prompt uses the Pulau Pinang entity. Qloo returned two entries with that name and gives no way to tell them apart. The Penang Bridge entry was left out because the bridge opened in 1985, after their youth.
No books or authors were looked up, so there is no book prompt.
Qloo describes the tastes of groups, not this person. Their own experiences may differ, and the card does not establish that they played badminton, flew kites or visited Penang.
The memory prompts rely only on details the family filled in, which were not seen when writing this card.

ar.theme: ذكريات من ماليزيا: الريشة الطائرة، والطائرات الورقية، ونكهات البيت
ar.opener: اليوم نجلس معًا بهدوء ونتحدث عن أشياء جميلة من أيام الشباب في كوالالمبور: الطعام الذي نحبه، والملاعب، ورحلات بينانغ، والطائرات الورقية في السماء. لا توجد إجابات صحيحة أو خاطئة، المهم أن نستمتع بالحديث.

prompts.title: الريشة الطائرة
prompts.activity: أمسكا معًا مضربًا وريشة إن توفرا، أو تصفحا صورًا لملاعب الريشة الطائرة، وجرّبا ضربات خفيفة إن سمحت الحالة.

prompts.question: حدّثني عن الناسي ليماك وكيف تحب أن يُقدَّم.

prompts.question: حدّثني عن الجلوس في كشك مامك، ومن كان يرافقك هناك.

prompts.title: كوالالمبور، مدينة الشباب

prompts.title: طبق من البيت
prompts.activity: إن أمكن، حضّرا معًا {{familyDish}} أو اجمعا مكوناته على الطاولة وتحدثا عنها.
prompts.question: حدّثني عن {{familyDish}} ومن كان يطهوه في البيت، أو عن أيامك مع {{relative}}.

caregiverTips: اختر وقتًا هادئًا من اليوم، واجعل الجلسة قصيرة ومريحة، وتوقف عند ظهور أي تعب.

إن أثار موضوع ما حزنًا، اعترف بالمشاعر بلطف وانتقل برفق إلى موضوع آخر.

لا تثبت البطاقة أي شيء خاص بفترة 1955 إلى 1980 تحديدًا، إذ لم تُرجع Qloo نتائج مرتبطة بتلك الحقبة.
يصف Qloo أذواق مجموعات من الناس، لا ذوق هذا الشخص بعينه، ولم تطّلع البطاقة على محتوى دفتر الذكريات العائلي.

en.theme: Life on the water and in the green heart of Bandar Seri Begawan
en.opener: Let's take a gentle stroll back to Bandar Seri Begawan, with its stilt houses on the river, the golden mosque on the lagoon, warm local food and football afternoons. There are no right or wrong answers. I'd just love to hear your stories.

prompts.question: Tell me about the times you passed by or visited this part of the city.

prompts.title: Jungle trails and waterfalls
prompts.activity: Look at photos of the forest paths and waterfall, or open a window and listen to birds together.
prompts.question: Tell me about spending time among the trees and water near the city.

prompts.title: A taste of home
prompts.activity: Cook or share a simple local Bruneian dish together, or look at pictures of ambuyat and other favourites.
prompts.question: Tell me about the local food you most enjoyed eating growing up.

prompts.title: Football days
prompts.activity: Look at photos of a football match or pass a ball gently back and forth.
prompts.question: Tell me what you enjoyed about football, whether playing it or watching it.

prompts.title: Time with family
prompts.activity: Look at any family photos together.
prompts.question: Tell me about the time you spent with {{relative}}.

prompts.title: A family dish

prompts.question: Tell me about {{familyDish}} and who sat down to share it.

If they seem tired or upset, gently switch to something calming or stop for the day.

ar.theme: بين الماء والغابة: ذكريات الصبا في بندر سري بكاوان
ar.opener: اليوم سنقوم بجولة هادئة في الأماكن والنكهات التي عرفتها بلدتك في أيام الشباب: القرية العائمة على النهر، والمسجد ذو القبة الذهبية، والغابة الخضراء، وطعام البيت. لا يوجد جواب صحيح أو خاطئ، كل ما يخطر ببالك يسعدنا أن نسمعه.

prompts.question: حدّثني عن الحياة على الماء، وعن الأصوات والمشاهد التي تخطر ببالك حين ترى هذه البيوت.

prompts.title: المسجد ذو القبة الذهبية

prompts.title: طبق الأمبويات

prompts.question: حدّثني عن الأمبويات، ومع من كنت تحب أن تتشاركه حول المائدة.

تأكّد بنفسك من أن الأماكن المذكورة كانت موجودة في أيام شبابه قبل أن تعرضها، واستبدل ما لا يناسب.

لم يكن ممكنًا توجيه البحث نحو الفئة العمرية الأكبر سنًا، فالنتائج غير مرجّحة لجيله.

لم يُعثر في Qloo على منتخب بروناي لكرة القدم ولا على لاعبين أو أندية، فبطاقة الرياضة تقوم على الملعب وحده؛ ولم يُعرف إن كان يحب رياضات أخرى.
البحث عن الأطعمة والغابات المطيرة أعطى نتائج غير ذات صلة، فلم يُعثر على أطباق بروناوية غير الأمبويات، ولم يُكرَّر البحث عن المحميات والشلالات.

en.theme: Growing up in Chicago: a good book, a ballgame and a slice of apple pie
en.opener: I thought we could spend a little time together with some favorite things: a story, some baseball, and maybe a slice of pie. There's no rush and nothing to get right. I'd just love to hear whatever comes to mind.

prompts.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
prompts.activity: Read the first page or two aloud together, or hold a copy and look at the cover side by side.
prompts.question: Tell me what a book like this brings to mind for you.

prompts.activity: Look at photos of Wrigley Field, the ivy-covered walls or an old Cubs cap or pennant together.
prompts.question: Tell me about what a day at the ballpark felt like.

prompts.title: Apple pie

prompts.question: Tell me about the apple pies you've enjoyed over the years.

prompts.title: Time with family
prompts.activity: Look through family photos together at an easy pace.
prompts.question: Tell me about spending time with {{relative}}.

If they can't recall something, gently move on or share a memory of your own. There are no wrong answers.
Use your senses: the smell of baking pie, the feel of a ballcap, the weight of a book in their hands.
Watch for tiredness or upset, and it's fine to stop early and simply sit together.

en.theme: Growing up in Manchester: stories, Saturday football, the chippy and days out in the Lakes
en.opener: I'd love to spend a little time chatting about when you were younger. There's no right or wrong here, just whatever comes to mind. Shall we start with a cup of tea?

prompts.title: Adventures with Enid Blyton
prompts.activity: Read a short passage from an Enid Blyton story aloud together, or look at a picture of an old book cover.
prompts.question: Tell me about the stories you liked to read or hear when you were young.

prompts.title: The Red Devils
prompts.activity: Look at a Manchester United scarf, badge or old photo of the ground together.
prompts.question: Tell me what match days felt like in Manchester when you were growing up.

prompts.title: Fish and chips
prompts.activity: Share a portion of fish and chips together, wrapped in paper if you can.
prompts.question: Tell me about getting fish and chips when you were younger. What was it like?

prompts.title: A trip to the Lake District
prompts.activity: Look through photos or a picture book of the Lake District together.
prompts.question: Tell me about trips out of the city. What was it like heading up to the Lakes?

prompts.title: Lakes and fell walks
prompts.activity: Take a gentle walk outside, or look at pictures of lakes and hills and talk about them.
prompts.question: Tell me how it feels to be out walking by the water and the hills.

prompts.title: Cooking a family favourite
prompts.activity: Cook or prepare {{familyDish}} together, or simply talk through how it was made.
prompts.question: Tell me about {{familyDish}} and who made it in your family.

prompts.title: Time with family
prompts.activity: Look at a photo that includes {{relative}}, if you have one.
prompts.question: Tell me about the things you and {{relative}} used to get up to.

caregiverTips: Go at a relaxed pace and pick just two or three prompts if that feels right.
If a question doesn't spark anything, move on gently. There's no need to fill in gaps or correct details.
Follow their lead. If a story wanders somewhere else, that's a good thing.
Smells, tastes and objects, like a warm bag of chips or a football scarf, often bring back more than words.
Stop while it's still enjoyable, and thank them for sharing.
limitations: Qloo describes what groups of people tend to like, not this person's actual tastes or history.
Only four items were confirmed in Qloo: Enid Blyton, Manchester United F.C., fish and chips tags and Lake District National Park. No related items from 1955 to 1980 were found.
No United players from the 1955 to 1980 era came back from Qloo, so none are named.
No specific Manchester fish and chip shops or markets were found, and no individual fells, lakes or villages in the Lake District were confirmed.
Age-targeted searches failed, so nothing here is confirmed as popular with people of this generation specifically.
Memory prompts rely on details the family entered, which were not seen when this card was written.

ar.theme: طفولة وشباب في مانشستر: حكايات المغامرة، وكرة القدم يوم السبت، ورائحة السمك والبطاطا، ونزهات بين البحيرات
ar.opener: اجلسا معًا في مكان هادئ ومريح، وقل بلطف: «خطر لي أن نتحدث اليوم قليلًا عن أيام زمان في مانشستر. لا داعي للعجلة، سأستمتع بأي شيء تحب أن تحكيه لي».

prompts.title: حكايات إنيد بلايتون
prompts.activity: اقرأ بصوت عالٍ صفحة أو صفحتين من إحدى قصص المغامرات للكاتبة الإنجليزية إنيد بلايتون، أو اعرض غلاف أحد كتبها القديمة.
prompts.question: حدثني عن القصص التي كنت تحب أن تقرأها أو تسمعها وأنت صغير.

prompts.title: الشياطين الحمر
prompts.activity: تصفحا معًا صورًا قديمة لنادي مانشستر يونايتد وملعبه وقمصانه الحمراء من الخمسينيات والستينيات والسبعينيات.
prompts.question: حدثني عن أيام المباريات في مانشستر وما كان يجري في الحي حينها.

prompts.title: جورج بست
prompts.activity: انظرا معًا إلى صور للاعب الكرة جورج بست في الستينيات، وتحدثا عن أسلوب لعبه.
prompts.question: أخبرني ما الذي كان يميز لاعبي الكرة في ذلك الزمن برأيك.

prompts.title: السمك والبطاطا
prompts.activity: حضّرا أو اطلبا طبقًا من السمك والبطاطا المقلية، وكُلاه معًا، ولو ملفوفًا بالورق على الطريقة القديمة إن أمكن.
prompts.question: حدثني عن مرات أكل السمك والبطاطا التي بقيت في بالك.

prompts.title: بحيرات منطقة ليك ديستريكت
prompts.activity: تصفحا صورًا للبحيرات والتلال ومسارات المشي في منتزه ليك ديستريكت الوطني، أو اخرجا في نزهة قصيرة في الهواء الطلق.
prompts.question: حدثني عن الأماكن الطبيعية التي كنت تحب الذهاب إليها خارج المدينة.

prompts.title: أيام مع شخص قريب
prompts.activity: اعرض صورًا عائلية قديمة، وتصفحاها ببطء معًا.
prompts.question: حدثني عن الأوقات التي قضيتها مع {{relative}}.

prompts.title: طبق من البيت
prompts.activity: حضّرا معًا {{familyDish}} أو بعض مكوناته، ودعه يشم الروائح ويلمس المكونات.
prompts.question: حدثني عن {{familyDish}} وعن المطبخ الذي كان يُحضَّر فيه.

caregiverTips: اختر موضوعين أو ثلاثة فقط في الجلسة الواحدة، ولا تحاول المرور على البطاقة كلها.

استمتع بالمشاعر التي تظهر أكثر من التفاصيل الدقيقة؛ فالابتسامة أهم من صحة التاريخ.
استعن بالحواس: الطعام والصور والهواء الطلق تفتح باب الحديث بسهولة.
إذا ظهر حزن أو تعب، أوقف الجلسة بلطف وقدّم كلمة طيبة أو فنجان شاي.
limitations: لم تُنتج خطوات التوصية في Qloo أي نتائج، لذلك لا توجد على هذه البطاقة اقتراحات من نوع «من يحب كذا يحب أيضًا كذا»؛ كل البنود مجرد تأكيد أن الأشياء المحبوبة المذكورة موجودة في Qloo.
تصف Qloo أذواق المجموعات لا هذا الشخص بعينه، ولا شيء في البطاقة يُعدّ حقيقة عن حياته.
اختيار لاعب الكرة جورج بست افتراض بناءً على الحقبة، ولم تذكر Qloo النادي الذي لعب له.
لم يُعثر على أماكن خاصة بمانشستر ولا على محلات سمك وبطاطا فيها، ولا على كتب أو مؤلفين مرتبطين بإنيد بلايتون.
لا تثبت البطاقة أن الشخص زار منطقة ليك ديستريكت فعلًا.
أسئلة دفتر الذكريات تعتمد على ما أدخلته العائلة فقط، ولم يُطّلع على مضمونه.

en.theme: Toronto childhood: storybooks, butter tarts, lake country and the Maple Leafs
en.opener: I brought a few things today that made me think of growing up in Toronto: an old favourite book, something sweet from the bakery, and a picture or two of cottage country. There's no hurry. Let's just enjoy them together and see where the conversation goes.

prompts.title: Anne of Green Gables
prompts.activity: Read a short passage aloud together, such as Anne's arrival at Green Gables, or look through an illustrated copy.
prompts.question: Tell me what you like about Anne and the way she sees the world.

prompts.title: Little Women
prompts.activity: Read aloud a short scene with the four March sisters, or look at pictures of the book's cover and illustrations.
prompts.question: Which of the sisters feels most like someone you know, and why?

prompts.title: Butter tarts
prompts.activity: Bake a small batch of butter tarts together, or share a few from a local bakery with a cup of tea or coffee.
prompts.question: Tell me about the butter tarts you've enjoyed. Do you like them runny or firm, with raisins or without?

prompts.title: Muskoka lakes
prompts.activity: Look at photos or a calendar of Muskoka lakes, docks and pine trees, and talk about what you see.
prompts.question: Tell me what a summer day by a lake like this feels like to you.

prompts.title: The Toronto Maple Leafs
prompts.activity: Look at an old Maple Leafs sweater, the blue-and-white logo, or photos of Maple Leaf Gardens together.
prompts.question: Tell me what it was like being a Leafs fan in Toronto when you were young.

prompts.title: Time with family
prompts.activity: Look at a family photo together and let the conversation wander.
prompts.question: Tell me about spending time with {{relative}} when you were growing up.

prompts.title: A family dish
prompts.activity: Cook {{familyDish}} together, or simply set out the ingredients and talk while you prepare it.
prompts.question: Tell me about {{familyDish}} and who made it in your family.

caregiverTips: Go at a slow, relaxed pace and follow their lead. If one topic doesn't spark interest, move on gently.
There are no right or wrong answers. Welcome whatever comes up, even if details change from one telling to the next.
Use your senses: the smell of baking, the feel of a hockey sweater, or the colours of a lake photo can open up conversation more than words alone.
If a topic brings up sadness, acknowledge the feeling kindly and switch to something comforting.
Keep the session short, about 20 to 30 minutes, and end on a pleasant note, perhaps with a butter tart.
limitations: Qloo describes what groups of people with similar tastes tend to enjoy. It does not describe this person, so every prompt is a suggestion to try, not a known fact about them.
Qloo had two editions of Anne of Green Gables, and the more popular one was assumed to be the right match.
Qloo returned no Canadian authors among related books, so Little Women comes from general readers' tastes, not Canadian ones.
No Maple Leafs players or moments from the 1955–1980 era were found or checked, so the sport prompt covers only the team itself.
No specific Toronto bakeries or Muskoka lakes and landmarks were found. Butter tarts and the Muskoka area are confirmed only as general topics.
Qloo's age-group setting was rejected both times, so none of the results are tuned to people of this generation.
The Muskoka area was chosen over the District Municipality of Muskoka, which was an assumption.
The memory prompts rely on details the family filled in, and this card does not know what those details are.

prompts.title: فريق تورونتو مايبل ليفز
